README.md:
# todos service

Set DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL URL with the postgresql+psycopg scheme.
The application does not use a local database fallback.

1. Run uv sync.
2. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
3. Run uv run uvicorn todos.app:app.
4. Open /docs for the API or /healthz for a database connection check.

Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to a separate PostgreSQL database before running
uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.
Run uv run alembic downgrade base to undo the migration.
alembic/env.py:
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

from todos.database import database_url
from todos.models import Base


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            with context.begin_transaction():
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

tests/test_todos.py:
import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from todos.app import app
from todos.database import engine
from todos.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "title": "sample",
        }
        created = self.client.post("/todos", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["completed"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/todos").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/todos" + f"/{item_id}", json={"completed": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["completed"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/todos", params={"completed": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/todos" + f"/{item_id}", json={"completed": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/todos", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/todos", params={"limit": 100 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)

import os
from collections.abc import Iterator

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def database_url() -> str:
    value = os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL", "")
    if not value.startswith("postgresql+psycopg://"):
        raise RuntimeError("DATABASE_URL must be a postgresql+psycopg URL")
    return value


engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    with Session(engine) as session:
        yield session

    description: str | None
    completed: bool

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    title: str | None = None
    description: str | None = None
    completed: bool | None = None

        nullable = {
            "title": False,
            "description": True,
            "completed": False,
        }
        for field in self.model_fields_set:
            if getattr(self, field) is None and not nullable[field]:
                raise ValueError(f"{field} cannot be null")
        return self

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from tickets.app import app
from tickets.database import engine
from tickets.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "code": "sample",
            "count": 3,
        }
        created = self.client.post("/tickets", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["resolved"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/tickets" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/tickets").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/tickets" + f"/{item_id}", json={"resolved": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["resolved"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/tickets", params={"resolved": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/tickets" + f"/{item_id}", json={"resolved": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/tickets", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/tickets", params={"limit": 50 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/tickets" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/tickets" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from notes.app import app
from notes.database import engine
from notes.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "name": "sample",
        }
        created = self.client.post("/notes", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["archived"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/notes" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/notes").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/notes" + f"/{item_id}", json={"archived": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["archived"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/notes", params={"archived": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/notes" + f"/{item_id}", json={"archived": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/notes", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/notes", params={"limit": 30 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/notes" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/notes" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from jobs.app import app
from jobs.database import engine
from jobs.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "label": "sample",
        }
        created = self.client.post("/jobs", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["enabled"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/jobs").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/jobs" + f"/{item_id}", json={"enabled": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["enabled"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/jobs", params={"enabled": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/jobs" + f"/{item_id}", json={"enabled": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/jobs", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/jobs", params={"limit": 100 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)

import os
import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from jobs.app import app
from jobs.database import engine
from jobs.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "label": "sample",
        }
        created = self.client.post("/jobs", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["enabled"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/jobs").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/jobs" + f"/{item_id}", json={"enabled": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["enabled"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/jobs", params={"enabled": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/jobs" + f"/{item_id}", json={"enabled": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/jobs", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/jobs", params={"limit": 100 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/jobs" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)

import unittest

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"]

from todos.app import app
from todos.database import engine
from todos.models import Base


class ServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
        self.client = TestClient(app)

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        Base.metadata.drop_all(engine)

    def test_crud_and_database(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/healthz").status_code, 200)
        payload = {
            "title": "sample",
        }
        created = self.client.post("/todos", json=payload)
        self.assertEqual(created.status_code, 201, created.text)
        row = created.json()
        self.assertIs(row["completed"], False)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["created_at"])
        self.assertIsNotNone(row["updated_at"])
        item_id = row["id"]
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.client.get("/todos").json()), 1)
        updated = self.client.patch(
            "/todos" + f"/{item_id}", json={"completed": True}
        )
        self.assertEqual(updated.status_code, 200, updated.text)
        self.assertIs(updated.json()["completed"], True)
        page = self.client.get(
            "/todos", params={"completed": True, "limit": 1, "offset": 0}
        )
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in page.json()], [item_id])
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.patch(
                "/todos" + f"/{item_id}", json={"completed": None}
            ).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/todos", params={"limit": 0}).status_code, 422
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.client.get("/todos", params={"limit": 20 + 1}).status_code,
            422,
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.client.delete("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 204)
        self.assertEqual(self.client.get("/todos" + f"/{item_id}").status_code, 404)
